::: {#teaching .block}
::: block-inner
## <i class="bi bi-mortarboard"></i> Teaching

Over the past few years, I have been a teaching assistant in the following classes
at École polytechnique.

::: cards
::: {#course-csm .card-item}
### Computational Solid Mechanics
[Graduate · M1 / Cycle ingénieur 3A · 2025]{.meta}

The Finite Element Method for linear and nonlinear solid mechanics problems:
concepts, implementation and code (FEniCS in Python).
:::

::: {#course-mh .card-item}
### Mechanics and Heat
[Undergraduate · L1 · 2024, 2025]{.meta}

An introductory class to basic mechanics and thermodynamics.
:::

::: {#course-sm .card-item}
### Solid Mechanics
[Undergraduate · L3 / M1 · 2023, 2024]{.meta}

Nonlinear mechanics of rods, with an emphasis on stability, waves and shocks.
:::

::: {#course-cfm .card-item}
### Computational Fluid Mechanics
[Graduate · M1 / Cycle ingénieur 3A · 2023]{.meta}

Solving computational fluid mechanics problems: time integration, finite
differences, stability, implementation in Python.
:::
:::
